title: Promote AA0471, AA0472 and AA0474 to Error in the base ruleset
summary: Three analyzer rules (AA0471, AA0472, AA0474) are promoted from None to Error in the base ruleset, with violations in the Withholding Tax app fixed by adding missing AutoFormatExpression attributes to amount fields.
key_points: AA0471, AA0472 and AA0474 are moved from None to Error in base.ruleset.json
AA0472 had no violations, so its override is simply removed
Missed amount fields in Withholding Tax Entry and WHT Empl. Ledger Entry Ext now use AutoFormatExpression = Rec."Currency Code"
WHT Threshold Accumulator gets an empty AutoFormatExpression because it only holds LCY amounts
AA0473 and AS0112 keep their overrides because CI found hundreds of violations
